environment.description: Service runs in private subnet (no IGW route) behind an internal NLB (network load balancer) with a VPC endpoint service configuration. Access is granted exclusively through AWS PrivateLink interface endpoints provisioned in two consumer VPCs (vpc-0xf3a1 belonging to the internal frontend team, vpc-0xb7c2 belonging to the QA automation account). The endpoint service has 'Acceptance Required' enabled and only the two known AWS account principals (arn:aws:iam::111222333444:root and arn:aws:iam::555666777888:root) are in the allowed-principals list. Additionally, the NLB target group health check path is /health and the NLB listener is configured on port 443 with TLS termination using an ACM certificate, meaning the service port 8080 is never exposed beyond the VPC. The private subnet's route table has no 0.0.0.0/0 route and NACL rules explicitly deny all inbound from 0.0.0.0/0. DNS resolution for the endpoint is private-only (no public DNS).

config.subnet_type: private, no IGW, no NAT for inbound
config.load_balancer: internal NLB with TLS listener on 443
config.nacl_inbound: deny 0.0.0.0/0 all ports (rule 100), allow only VPC CIDR 10.0.0.0/16 (rule 50)
